name: coordinator-single-item-dispatch
body:
The coordinator dispatches exactly one feedback item per writer invocation, and dispatches it to the writer that owns the feedback's target. Ownership is by target type: a spec-tier target (a requirement, domain, solution, constraint, or note node) is owned by the spec-writer; a plan target (a plan, phase, or task) is owned by the plan-writer; a code target is owned by the implementer. The coordinator selects a single Feedback item (status `open`), gives the owning writer that item (its FQN and body), and that writer fixes or explores only that item and returns a claim of ACTIONED (with the change) or WONT-FIX (with justification). The coordinator must never batch multiple feedback items into one writer dispatch and must never hand an item to a writer that does not own its target; the writer's response is the claim alone — the writer does not action the item.

Acceptance: one dispatch carries exactly one feedback FQN; the dispatched writer is the owner of the item's target (the spec-writer for a spec-tier target, the plan-writer for a plan/phase/task target, the implementer for a code target), so a spec-tier target is never dispatched to the implementer; a writer handed one item returns one claim; the coordinator never issues a dispatch covering two or more open items.
